subtitle: When Kalyani’s Torch Dimmed, New Flames Rose Across the Deccan

panels.shot: epic wide of the Deccan plateau with multiple forts glowing at dusk
panels.action: The Western Chalukya Commander of Kalyani stands on a ridge, silhouetted against a vast Deccan landscape where distant citadels at Dwarasamudra, Devagiri and Warangal gleam like separate suns.

dialogue.text: As Western Chalukya Kalyani fades in the late 12th century, Hoysala, Seuna and Kakatiya chiefs turn from loyal vassals into kings, reshaping the very map of the Deccan.

i18n.hi: बारहवीं सदी के अंत तक कल्याणी चालुक्य ढलते हैं, और होयसला, सेना, काकतीय सरदार वफ़ादार जागीरदार से राजा बनकर पूरे दक्कन का नक्शा बदल देते हैं।

panels.shot: slow push-in from the bustling court of Kalyani towards the commander’s thoughtful face
panels.action: In the audience hall at Kalyani, the Western Chalukya Commander of Kalyani watches a tired overlord on the throne as minor chiefs whisper in clustered groups along the pillars.

dialogue.text: Kalyani was once the proud centre of Western Chalukya power, binding chiefs across the Deccan. By c.1138 CE, the bindings were fraying, even as the royal court tried to act unchanged.

i18n.hi: कल्याणी कभी पश्चिमी चालुक्य ताकत का गर्वीला केंद्र था, जो दक्कन के सरदारों को बाँधता था। पर लगभग 1138 ई. तक ये बंधन ढीले पड़ने लगे, भले ही दरबार पुराने ढंग से ही खेलने की कोशिश करता रहा।

panels.shot: bird’s-eye over a map-table showing routes from Kalyani to Dwarasamudra, Devagiri and Warangal
panels.action: The commander leans over a rough map of the Deccan scratched on a wooden board, small carved tokens marking Dwarasamudra, Devagiri and Warangal at the edges of Chalukya territory.

dialogue.text: From Kalyani, orders once ran to Dwarasamudra, Devagiri and Warangal. But roads that carried tribute and troops now carried questions: how long would these chiefs bow to a weakening centre?

i18n.hi: कल्याणी से कभी आदेश द्वारसमुद्र, देवगिरि और वारंगल तक दौड़ते थे। पर जिन सड़कों से कभी नज़राना और सेना जाती थी, अब सवाल जाते हैं: कमज़ोर होते केंद्र को ये सरदार कब तक झुकते रहेंगे?

panels.shot: close-up on the commander’s hand receiving a palm-leaf inscription record
panels.action: A royal clerk places a fresh palm-leaf bundle in the commander’s hands, its edges inscribed with titles and honorifics that spill beyond older formulas.

dialogue.text: Inscriptions begin to tell the story. Hoysala, Seuna-Yadava and Kakatiya records stretch their chiefs’ titles, claiming glory not just as feudatories, but as lords in their own right.

i18n.hi: अब कहानी शिलालेखों में खुलती है। होयसला, सेना-यादव और काकतीय अभिलेख अपने सरदारों की पदवियाँ लंबी कर देते हैं—अब सिर्फ जागीरदार नहीं, खुद के अधिकार के स्वामी घोषित होते हैं।

panels.shot: imagined cutaway: inscription carved on stone, commander observing in the background
panels.action: At a temple site, the commander watches sculptors chisel long royal epithets into stone, the words for ‘independent ruler’ and grand birudas carefully carved beside older Chalukya references.

dialogue.text: Where once Chalukya emperors were named first, new stones place regional chiefs at the centre. The language of loyalty slowly shifts to the language of sovereignty.

i18n.hi: जहाँ कभी पहले चालुक्य सम्राटों का नाम उभरता था, नई शिलाएँ क्षेत्रीय सरदारों को केंद्र में रखती हैं। वफ़ादारी की भाषा धीरे-धीरे हक और हुकूमत की भाषा बन जाती है।

panels.shot: medium shot in council chamber with commander debating with other officers
panels.action: In a dim council chamber, the commander argues with fellow officers, their faces tense as they discuss thin tax ledgers and reports of distant chiefs withholding dues.

dialogue.text: Late Western Chalukya and Kalachuri records speak of shrinking revenue and contested rights. Political strain and fiscal weakness loosen the net that once held the Deccan together.

i18n.hi: देर के चालुक्य और कालचुरी अभिलेख घटती आमदनी और झगड़ालू अधिकारों की बात करते हैं। राजनीतिक तनाव और माली कमज़ोरी उस जाल को ढीला कर देती है जो कभी पूरे दक्कन को एक साथ बाँधता था।

panels.shot: low-angle of commander on ramparts of Kalyani, looking toward the horizon
panels.action: On the fort walls of Kalyani, the commander grips the parapet, staring toward the hazy hills where Dwarasamudra lies, as if measuring the distance of loyalty.

dialogue.text: By the mid-12th century, Western Chalukya authority becomes a loose framework. Powerful feudatories learn they can stand inside it when useful, and step outside it when it binds too tight.

i18n.hi: बारहवीं सदी के बीच आते-आते पश्चिमी चालुक्य हुकूमत बस एक ढीला ढाँचा रह जाती है। ताकतवर जागीरदार सीख जाते हैं कि काम पड़े तो भीतर रहें, और ज़्यादा कसने लगे तो बाहर निकल जाएँ।

panels.shot: montage-style wide showing three distant courts simultaneously
panels.action: The scene splits across the horizon: a Hoysala court at Dwarasamudra, a Seuna-Yadava durbar at Devagiri, and a Kakatiya hall at Warangal, each lord seated confidently amid their own banners.

dialogue.text: In Karnataka, at Dwarasamudra, Hoysala rulers claim wider command. At Devagiri, Seuna-Yadavas speak as masters of their plateau. At Warangal, Kakatiyas build power in Telingana.

i18n.hi: कर्नाटक के द्वारसमुद्र में होयसला राजाओं की दावेदारी फैलती है। देवगिरि पर सेना-यादव खुद को पठार के मालिक बताते हैं। वारंगल में काकतीय तेलिंगाना में अपनी शक्ति गढ़ते हैं।

panels.shot: close-up of commander reading an inscription praising a regional chief as ‘maharaja’
panels.action: Seated by lamplight, the commander traces with his finger a line on stone that hails a chief as ‘maharaja of many lands’, his brows tightening at the bold claim.

dialogue.text: Inscriptional titles grow higher: ‘maharaja’, ‘ruler of many countries’. These chiefs no longer describe themselves as mere servants of Kalyani, even when they still nod to Chalukya suzerainty.

i18n.hi: शिलालेखों की पदवियाँ ऊँची होती जाती हैं: ‘महाराज’, ‘अनेकों देशों का स्वामी’। ये सरदार अब खुद को सिर्फ कल्याणी के नौकर नहीं कहते, भले चालुक्य अधिपत्य को औपचारिक सलाम अभी भी कर दें।

panels.shot: dynamic medium shot of commander receiving messengers from three directions
panels.action: In a courtyard, three dusty messengers arrive from Dwarasamudra, Devagiri and Warangal, each laying sealed reports before the commander who kneels to open them.

dialogue.text: Messages bring mixed answers: help offered when it suits, delay or refusal when it does not. The network turns from straight lines of command into a web of bargaining and selective support.

i18n.hi: संदेशों के जवाब भी मिले-जुले हैं: काम पड़े तो मदद, न सूट करे तो टालना या इन्कार। सीधी आज्ञा-रेखाएँ अब सौदेबाज़ी और चुनिंदा सहारे का उलझा हुआ जाल बन जाती हैं।

panels.shot: tense close-up on commander’s face lit by flickering torchlight
panels.action: At night, torchlight throws sharp shadows over the commander’s worried face as he listens to a report of a feudatory minting coins in his own name.

dialogue.text: This was not one sudden defeat, nor a single battle that toppled an empire. It was a long, uneven shift, as regional houses quietly build their own bases and symbols of rule.

i18n.hi: ये कोई एक ही हार नहीं थी, न एक ही जंग जिसने साम्राज्य गिरा दिया। ये लंबा, टेढ़ा बदलाव था, जिसमें क्षेत्रीय घराने चुपचाप अपनी ही नींव और राजचिह्न गढ़ते रहे।

panels.shot: wide shot of Kalyani court being ignored while regional courts celebrate
panels.action: While musicians play before a modest Kalyani throne, the background fades into imagined scenes of grand celebrations in Hoysala, Seuna and Kakatiya courts, each joyfully honoring their own rulers.

dialogue.text: Scholars like Nilakanta Sastri, B.R. Gopal and B.D. Chattopadhyaya read these traces as the making of regional states. The Chalukya frame weakens; new centres of loyalty and identity grow.

i18n.hi: नीलकंठ शास्त्री, बी.आर. गोपाल, बी.डी. चट्टोपाध्याय जैसे विद्वान इन निशानों में क्षेत्रीय राज्यों की बनावट पढ़ते हैं। चालुक्य ढाँचा ढीला पड़ता है; वफ़ादारी और पहचान के नए केंद्र उगते हैं।

panels.shot: medium shot in war council, commander pointing at map fragments
panels.action: Around a low table, the commander points to a map now drawn in separate colored regions, his officers murmuring as they grasp how the land has split into many spheres of influence.

dialogue.speaker: the_hoysala_seuna_and_kakatiya_chiefs
dialogue.text: We no longer command an empire; we negotiate among rising kingdoms.

i18n.hi: अब हम साम्राज्य नहीं चलाते; उभरती रियासतों के बीच सौदे करते हैं।

panels.shot: slow pull-back from Kalyani fort to reveal surrounding territories beyond its reach
panels.action: The camera draws back from the Kalyani fortress, revealing stretches of countryside and distant forts now visually separated by different standards fluttering over each stronghold.

dialogue.text: Western Chalukya and Kalachuri records from Kalyani show shrinking reach. What was once imperial command becomes local control, surrounded by ambitious neighbors shaped by its own old system.

i18n.hi: कल्याणी से मिले चालुक्य और कालचुरी अभिलेख घटती पहुँच दिखाते हैं। कभी जो आदेश साम्राज्य भर में गूंजते थे, वे अब स्थानीय हुक्म बन जाते हैं—चारों ओर वही महत्वाकांक्षी पड़ोसी, जिन्हें पुराना ढाँचा ही गढ़ता था।

panels.shot: poetic wide of Deccan plateau at dawn with multiple banners on the horizon
panels.action: At dawn, the commander stands alone, watching the Deccan plateau glow as multiple banners rise on far hills, each marking a Hoysala, Seuna or Kakatiya domain.

dialogue.text: The fall of Kalyani is not an empty ending. It is the opening for Hoysala, Seuna-Yadava and Kakatiya stories to unfold as full kingdoms, each carrying pieces of Chalukya legacy in new forms.

i18n.hi: कल्याणी का पतन खाली अंत नहीं है। ये मौका है कि होयसला, सेना-यादव और काकतीय की कहानियाँ पूरे राज्य बनकर फैले, हर एक में चालुक्य विरासत के टुकड़े नए रूपों में चले आएँ।

panels.shot: close-up of commander placing the old Chalukya seal beside new regional emblems
panels.action: In a quiet room, the commander gently sets down the Western Chalukya seal, then lays beside it small emblems of Hoysala, Seuna and Kakatiya houses, pausing between them.

dialogue.text: Inscription by inscription, coin by coin, title by title, an empire’s authority dissolves into many centres. The record shows not collapse into chaos, but reordering into layered regional powers.

i18n.hi: शिलालेख दर शिलालेख, सिक्का दर सिक्का, पदवी दर पदवी साम्राज्य की सत्ता कई केंद्रों में घुल जाती है। रिकॉर्ड दिखाता है गिरती अराजकता नहीं, बल्कि परतदार क्षेत्रीय ताकतों में नई जमावट।

panels.shot: final wide shot of Deccan with layered timelines subtly suggested in the landscape
panels.action: The commander fades into the landscape as the view settles over the Deccan, forts, fields and temple towers hinting at the many histories that will rise from this shared soil.

dialogue.text: An empire’s ending can be the beginning of many histories; in the late 12th-century Deccan, the weakening of Kalyani becomes the bridge by which vassals step into the long, crowded road of kings.

i18n.hi: किसी साम्राज्य का अंत कई इतिहासों की शुरुआत हो सकता है; बारहवीं सदी के अंत के दक्कन में कल्याणी की कमज़ोरी वही पुल बनती है, जिससे जागीरदार राजाओं की लंबी, भीड़भाड़ भरी राह पर कदम रखते हैं।

subtitle_i18n.en: When Kalyani’s Torch Dimmed, New Flames Rose Across the Deccan
subtitle_i18n.hi: कल्याणी की मशाल मंद पड़ी, दक्कन में नई लौ उठी
